title: Moving the remote from the Gladstone to Hayes on Louisiana Avenue
summary: The Gladstone grew too small, so the broadcast moved to Hayes at 2621 Louisiana Avenue near Flint-Goodrich Hospital.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: We were talking, but your remote was from the Gladstone.

From the Gladstone, and also from Hayes. Yeah, well, you see, the Gladstone started getting small, because when people found out that I was on the air, it started flooding the place. There was no place to put them, so I had to find another venue. So I had to go to Hayes, which was a larger place at the time. I should have brought the pictures and everything with me.
Now, Hayes was on Louisiana Avenue?
Right down the street, two blocks from Flint Goodwitch's Hospital. Okay. Mm-hmm.
